with observations as (
 select *,cast(observed_at_utc as date) as observation_date
 from "fy2025-full"."FACTS_INPUT"."job_observations"
 qualify row_number() over(partition by job_key,cast(observed_at_utc as date)
 order by observed_at_utc desc,source_sha256 desc)=1
)
select j.job_key as posting_id,j.job_key,j.source_provider,j.source_board,j.observation_date,
 d.date_key as observation_date_key,j.observed_at_utc,j.source_url,j.source_sha256,j.payload_json,
 case when j.source_provider='lever' then json_extract_string(cast(j.payload_json as json), '/' || replace(replace('text', '~', '~0'), '/', '~1'))
 else json_extract_string(cast(j.payload_json as json), '/' || replace(replace('title', '~', '~0'), '/', '~1')) end as job_title,
 case when j.source_provider='greenhouse' then json_extract_string(cast(j.payload_json as json), '/' || replace(replace('company_name', '~', '~0'), '/', '~1'))
 when j.source_provider='postgres_cdc' then json_extract_string(cast(j.payload_json as json), '/' || replace(replace('company_name', '~', '~0'), '/', '~1')) end as source_employer_name,
 case when j.source_provider='greenhouse' then json_extract_string(cast(json_extract_string(cast(j.payload_json as json), '/' || replace(replace('location', '~', '~0'), '/', '~1')) as json), '/' || replace(replace('name', '~', '~0'), '/', '~1'))
 when j.source_provider='lever' then json_extract_string(cast(json_extract_string(cast(j.payload_json as json), '/' || replace(replace('categories', '~', '~0'), '/', '~1')) as json), '/' || replace(replace('location', '~', '~0'), '/', '~1'))
 else json_extract_string(cast(j.payload_json as json), '/' || replace(replace('location', '~', '~0'), '/', '~1')) end as location_raw,
 case when j.source_provider='ashby' then json_extract_string(cast(j.payload_json as json), '/' || replace(replace('jobUrl', '~', '~0'), '/', '~1'))
 when j.source_provider='lever' then json_extract_string(cast(j.payload_json as json), '/' || replace(replace('hostedUrl', '~', '~0'), '/', '~1'))
 else json_extract_string(cast(j.payload_json as json), '/' || replace(replace('absolute_url', '~', '~0'), '/', '~1')) end as job_url,
 cast(null as varchar) as employer_id,cast(null as varchar) as employer_key,
 cast(null as varchar) as occupation_key,cast(null as varchar) as geography_key,
 'UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_EMPLOYER' as employer_mapping_status,'UNRESOLVED_FREE_TEXT' as occupation_mapping_status,
 'UNRESOLVED_FREE_TEXT' as geography_mapping_status,
 case when j.source_provider='ashby' then cast(json_extract_string(cast(j.payload_json as json), '/' || replace(replace('isListed', '~', '~0'), '/', '~1')) as boolean) end as is_listed,

select l.*,
 o.occupation_key, g.geography_key, x.employer_id,
 case when l.soc_code_raw is null or trim(l.soc_code_raw) = '' then 'SOURCE_SOC_MISSING'
      when l.soc_code is null then 'SOURCE_SOC_MALFORMED'
      when o.occupation_key is null then 'SOC_NOT_IN_2018_REFERENCE'
      else 'MATCHED' end as occupation_mapping_status,
 case when l.geography_status not in ('MATCHED','MATCHED_FROM_ZIP','MATCHED_FROM_CITY') then l.geography_status
      when g.geography_key is null then 'DIMENSION_COUNTY_MAPPING_FAILED'
      else 'MATCHED' end as county_mapping_status,
 g.cbsa_status,
 case when x.employer_id is null then 'UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_EMPLOYER'
      when first_snapshot.first_valid_from is null then 'DIMENSION_EMPLOYER_MAPPING_FAILED'
      when l.decision_date is null then 'SOURCE_FACT_DATE_MISSING'
      when l.decision_date < first_snapshot.first_valid_from then 'PRE_SNAPSHOT_HISTORY_UNKNOWN'
      else 'CAPTURE_TIME_LOOKUP_REQUIRED' end as employer_history_status
from "fy2025-full"."DIMENSIONS_INPUT"."lca_attributes" l
left join "fy2025-full"."MARTS"."dim_occupation" o on l.soc_code = o.soc_code and o.soc_vintage = 'SOC2018'
left join "fy2025-full"."MARTS"."dim_geography" g
 on l.county_fips = g.county_fips and l.geography_vintage = g.county_reference_vintage
left join "fy2025-full"."DIMENSIONS_INPUT"."employer_sources" x
 on l.source_system = x.source_system and l.source_employer_key = x.source_employer_key
left join (select employer_id,min(valid_from) as first_valid_from from "fy2025-full"."MARTS"."dim_employer" group by employer_id) first_snapshot
 on x.employer_id = first_snapshot.employer_id

-- Reconsider the retained source history, so a late old record never overwrites a newer winner.
with winners as (
 select * from "fy2025-full"."INTERMEDIATE"."int_lca_case_candidates"
 where nullif(trim(case_number),'') is not null
 qualify row_number() over(partition by case_number order by winner_rank)=1
), history as (
 select w.case_number,count(d.employer_key) as matching_versions,max(d.employer_key) as employer_key
 from winners w left join "fy2025-full"."MARTS"."dim_employer" d
 on w.employer_id=d.employer_id and d.valid_from<=cast(w.decision_date as timestamp)
 and (d.valid_to is null or d.valid_to>=cast(w.decision_date as timestamp)+interval '1 day')
 group by w.case_number
), first_capture as (
 select employer_id,min(valid_from) as first_valid_from from "fy2025-full"."MARTS"."dim_employer" group by employer_id
)
select w.case_number,w.case_status,w.case_status like 'Certified%' as is_certified,
 w.visa_class,w.job_title,w.employer_name as source_employer_name,w.source_employer_key,
 w.employer_id,case when h.matching_versions=1 then h.employer_key end as employer_key,
 case when w.employer_id is null then 'UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_EMPLOYER'
 when w.decision_date is null then 'SOURCE_FACT_DATE_MISSING'
 when cast(w.decision_date as timestamp)+interval '1 day'<=f.first_valid_from then 'PRE_SNAPSHOT_HISTORY_UNKNOWN'
 when h.matching_versions=1 then 'MATCHED_CAPTURE_INTERVAL'
 else 'DATE_PRECISION_OR_INTERVAL_UNKNOWN' end as employer_history_status,
 'DATE_ONLY' as fact_time_precision,w.occupation_key,w.geography_key,
 d.date_key as decision_date_key,w.decision_date,w.received_date,w.begin_date,w.end_date,
 w.soc_code_raw,w.soc_code,w.occupation_mapping_status,w.county_mapping_status,
 w.wage_amount,w.wage_unit,cast(w.annual_wage as decimal(24,2)) as annual_wage,
 cast(w.worker_positions as decimal(38,0)) as worker_positions,
 w.source_system,w.source_release,w.source_sha256,w.source_url,w.source_row_number,w.fiscal_year,
 w.worksite_state,
 cast(w.source_occurrence_count as bigint) as source_occurrence_count,
 case when w.chronological_tie_count>1 then 'SAME_DATE_TIE_REVIEW_REQUIRED' else 'UNAMBIGUOUS_LATEST' end as latest_selection_status
from winners w join history h using(case_number)
left join first_capture f on w.employer_id=f.employer_id
left join "fy2025-full"."MARTS"."dim_date" d on w.decision_date=d.calendar_date
